usage: • Common everyday noun for a journalist or reporter in Hong Kong news and media contexts.
• Can be used on its own, or with job-related words like 電視記者, 新聞記者, or 記者會.
• Neutral and very common; suitable for both spoken Cantonese and written news-related talk.
• For learners, remember it refers to the person doing journalism, not the news article itself.
